title: Token Efficiency V4 P3 - Deterministic Read-Once Semantic Context
objective: Reduce repeated repository reading and semantic rediscovery in routine engineering sessions by compiling bounded, fingerprinted, task-specific source and test spans locally before a model session, while preserving P2 tool isolation, runner-owned deterministic validation, independent review and all authority boundaries.
success_criteria: Routine developer briefings can include multiple deterministically selected source/test spans under one hard context budget.
Compiled spans are derived only from authorized files, declared tests and deterministic repository indexes.
The compiled context is fingerprinted and persisted as runner evidence before the provider session.
The model retains Read as a fallback when compiled context is insufficient; compiler misses cannot block valid engineering work.
P2 restrictions remain unchanged: no Bash or TodoWrite for consumer developer sessions, no unrelated MCP, no model-owned deterministic test loop and no model git operations.
Static regression tests prove stable ranking, hard budgets, deterministic fingerprints, authority monotonicity and fallback behavior.
A later matched benchmark demonstrates lower repeated reads/cache-read units without a regression in deterministic tests, independent review or integration readiness.
forbidden: removing Read as a safety fallback

benchmark_accounting.baseline: P2 correction high-read pattern at commit 615dfea4ddadc56bedc108d91aae1663448f9f94
quality_floor: integration gate READY with zero blockers
